title: Agent image tools: plain enlarge, background removal and crop
description: The agent cannot enlarge without a model, remove a still image's background, or crop: resize/imageUpscale/removeBackground are universal ops reachable only from the History tool rail (the connector's generate route needs a modelId that lists the op), cutout_gif/edit_gif refuse stills (NOT_A_GIF), and the project crop-media route writes a file with no card entry. Shape: expose them as catalogue ops the agent's generate tool can run with no model (landing as a new entry on the source card), so the tool schema does not grow. Fabio: likely version 1.
